reviews.title: Thieves
reviews.text: Do not buy anything and maybe do not download this at all. I was offered for 3 day trial, but they immediately charged me the price after it.

reviews.title: Do not get tricked
reviews.text: Awfully deceived by this app from the moment I entered their website. Two clicks in and 50$ were withdrawn from my account! Big No!
reviews.reply:
